<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan retailer of mattresses, sommiers, furniture, refrigerators, air conditioners and household goods, with its own online store on the Fenicio platform. States shipping to the whole country at a standard rate, with pickup centres in Montevideo.
